description:
A chemical warehouse with a water-filled containment basin needs a spill response plan. Look up the Specific Gravity of these five chemicals on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/): 1) Carbon Tetrachloride, 2) Toluene, 3) Chloroform, 4) n-Hexane, 5) Carbon Disulfide. 

Determine if each sinks or floats in water (Water SG = 1.00). 

Create a file at `/home/ga/Desktop/spill_layering_results.txt` that predicts the physical layering order of these chemicals if spilled together into the water basin. 

The file must list the layers from BOTTOM (heaviest/highest SG) to TOP (lightest/lowest SG). 

Format each line exactly like this:
Layer 1 (Bottom): [Chemical Name] - SG: [Value]
Layer 2: [Chemical Name] - SG: [Value]
...
Layer 6 (Top): [Chemical Name] - SG: [Value]
